question: In March 2023, Rajasthan became the first state in India to provide right to _________ for its people.
solution:
The correct answer is __**health**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In March 2023, Rajasthan became the first state in India to provide the right to **health** for its people.
 
• This landmark initiative aims to ensure that every resident of Rajasthan has access to quality healthcare services.
 
• The right to health includes various provisions such as free medical consultations, essential medicines, and diagnostic tests at government healthcare facilities.
 
• This move is a significant step towards universal healthcare and aims to reduce the financial burden of medical expenses on the citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rajasthan's initiative aligns with the global Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly Goal 3, which aims to ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.
 
• The state government has allocated a significant portion of its budget to improve healthcare infrastructure and services.
 
• This initiative is expected to serve as a model for other states in India, encouraging them to prioritize healthcare as a fundamental right.
 
• Public awareness campaigns and community health programs are being conducted to educate people about their rights and available healthcare services.
